CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when GiftsThisYearAmount meets or exceeds the Entry.Annual_Min_Amount__c value in FQS_Donor_Grouping custom metadata. Note: GiftsThisYearAmount is a calendar-year rollup from NPC. Thresholds are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping or the FQS Donor Grouping Configurator screen flow. Changing threshold values in Setup or via the configurator flow recalculates this field across all Donor Gift Summary records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required. Reports and dashboards using this field will reflect the new values immediately.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. Marked TRUE when this donor's current-year giving qualifies for the Entry giving tier. Your administrator controls the threshold amount.
CustomField.label: Is Entry Annual Donor
